data.name: Bishra
data.gender_notes: Bishra is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word "Bashar" meaning man or human. The name Bishra signifies the light, brightness, and illumination that a human being brings to the world. It is also associated with the light of faith and guidance given by Allah. The name Bishra carries the meaning “Brightness, illumination” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Bishra usually hope their child will grow to embody brightness, illumination and live with faith, good character and purpose.
